runtime_gates: Authorized NVIDIA driver/runtime injection, nvidia-smi, assigned B200 GPUs, and actual native BF16/FP8 CUDA execution remain unqualified.
The caller supplies every frozen script policy, threshold, duration, selection, result mount, and permission; this image grants no live approval.
MPI requires same-Pod/runtime-provided SSH authorization and fresh runtime host keys; no SSH keys or service are baked into the image.
Keep the image working directory /opt/gpu-burn for the frozen gpu_burn argv and its compare.fatbin; preserve the four-component burn protocol.
Bandwidth/NCCL require actual local topology and explicit transports; standalone Socket/bond0 is not an IB or multi-node claim.
CPU/NUMA requires the approved host view, allowed CPU/memory bindings, and scratch-executable permissions.
fio requires the exact approved ext4 scratch mount/source and private files; no raw-device or mount-policy substitution is authorized.
Health and burn require authorized kernel telemetry/current-boot journal visibility; installation does not supply host access.
Native build, Dapple functional validation, reviewed image approval, and an approved registry publication are separate gates.
